rows.desktop_responsibility: Maintain the authenticated GrokBotService WatchSandBoxMigration server stream, resume from offset_key, include finished operations, reconnect after drops, and project phase/detail/operation identity into the product migration state.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: Computer rebuild/update progress survives stream drops and app lifetime transitions without accepting stale terminal events from another operation.
rows.ios_platform_delta: URLSession Connect server-streaming replaces Electron/Node Connect transport. CoordinatorMcpSurface owns the single authenticated lifecycle stream, resumes with offsetKey, reconnects after three seconds, resets a rejected stale resume offset, fences terminal events by operationId, and cancels state on account-scope change.
rows.production_evidence: IOSCursorDashboardClient.watchSandBoxMigration uses aiserver.v1.GrokBotService/WatchSandBoxMigration with application/connect+proto framing; CoordinatorMcpSurface.ensureComputerMigrationWatch/ingestComputerMigration is the shipping main-RPC serving owner; IOSRemoteComputerRebuildSource now enables managed lifecycle only through that route.
rows.test_evidence: mobile/ios/FabushiTests/CursorSandBoxLifecycleClientTests.swift validates canonical streaming path/content type, framed fromOffsetKey/includeFinished request, event phase/detail/atMs/offsetKey/operationId projection, EndStream handling, and truncated-envelope rejection. Exact-head GitHub Actions pending.
rows.notes: Implemented against Desktop 798cf51d box-migration-watcher authority; not verified until exact-head Actions execute successfully.

rows.desktop_responsibility: Own the shipping computer recovery composition: start migration relay, retain latest/terminal migration state, bind recreate commands to accepted operation IDs, expose getBoxMigrationStatus/update/reset behavior, and dispose the watcher.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: The Computer surface has one lifecycle owner for update/reset/recovery status rather than method-table-only calls or duplicated transport state.
rows.ios_platform_delta: CoordinatorMcpSurface replaces Electron main-process BoxRecovery and intercepts lifecycle RPC before Host. It owns stream lifetime, latest/terminal status, accepted operation fencing, account-scope teardown, and the existing RemoteComputerRebuildOwner consumes that one route.
rows.production_evidence: MahayanaCoordinator.request routes through CoordinatorMcpSurface before hostSupervisor; CoordinatorMcpSurface now handles getBoxMigrationStatus/updateComputer/forceRecreateComputer and owns the authenticated dashboard lifecycle client and watcher; RemoteComputerRebuildSource.supportsManagedLifecycle is true only after this serving path exists.
rows.test_evidence: CursorSandBoxLifecycleClientTests plus existing RemoteComputerRebuildTests cover wire transport, reconnect-facing projections, operation-ID stale terminal fencing in the UI reducer, update/reset/reconnect behavior, and fail-closed behavior when lifecycle support is unavailable. Exact-head GitHub Actions pending.
rows.notes: Implemented production wiring; Desktop watchdog telemetry/stall-rearm policy remains part of broader telemetry parity and is not claimed by this row as verified until exact-head acceptance.

rows.desktop_responsibility: Translate product update/reset commands into canonical GrokBotService recreation requests, preserve data for update, surface started/started-untrackable/rejected results, and bind accepted operation IDs to migration tracking.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: Update Computer preserves user data, Reset Computer force-recreates, and the visible progress banner follows the exact backend operation that was accepted.
rows.ios_platform_delta: iOS reuses Cursor auth/inference headers and canonical Connect protobuf service directly: updateComputer maps to RecreateSandBox(preserve_data=true, force), reset maps to ForceRecreateSandBox, and no invented REST endpoint or second credentials owner is introduced.
rows.production_evidence: IOSCursorDashboardClient.recreateSandBox/forceRecreateSandBox serve aiserver.v1.GrokBotService unary Connect RPCs; CoordinatorMcpSurface.projectRecreate returns Desktop-compatible started/started-untrackable/rejected shapes and records the accepted operationId.
rows.test_evidence: CursorSandBoxLifecycleClientTests asserts exact GrokBotService method paths, Connect protocol headers, RecreateSandBox protobuf preserveData/force fields, empty ForceRecreateSandBox request, and operationId response decoding. Exact-head GitHub Actions pending.
rows.notes: Implemented against Desktop 798cf51d box-recreate-commands and main-edge updateComputer mapping; not verified until exact-head Actions pass.
